app.name: Overturn
app.short_description: QA for AI-drafted replies: untouched rate, fixes by reason, and a test before every model change.
app.long_description: Your agents already review every AI-drafted reply before it goes out. Overturn records what the AI wrote, what the agent sent and why it changed, with a one-click reason, whichever tool drafted the reply. You get the untouched rate and the fixes by reason, by team and by week (never a per-agent rate), and every fix replays as a regression test before the next model or prompt change. The app reads a ticket only after an AI draft appears in its reply box.
app.installation_instructions: Create a project API key in Overturn (Settings → API keys) and paste it into the app settings. Set the workflow name (one suite per workflow). Optionally list the custom fields that carry the decision as id:label pairs, and a scope tag to limit which tickets are watched.

overturn_api_key.label: Overturn API key
overturn_api_key.helpText: A project API key from Overturn (Settings → API keys). Stored by Zendesk, never sent to the browser.

overturn_base_url.label: Overturn API URL
overturn_base_url.helpText: Your Overturn API URL when self-hosting. Add its host to the app's domain allowlist.

agent.label: Workflow name
agent.helpText: The workflow name. One regression suite per workflow.

reason_pack.label: Reason pack
reason_pack.helpText: Which one-click reasons agents see when they change a draft: "support" (wrong answer, missing information, should have escalated...) or "claims" (coverage, reserve, exclusion...). Defaults to support.

require_reason.label: Require a reason for changed replies
require_reason.helpText: Block the send until the agent picks a reason (one click) when they changed the draft. On by default: a changed decision without a reason is not a test.

capture_internal_notes.label: Capture internal notes too
capture_internal_notes.helpText: Also capture internal notes, not only public replies.

decision_fields.label: Decision fields
decision_fields.helpText: Custom fields that are the decision, as id:label pairs, e.g. custom_field_123:coverage, custom_field_456:reserve, custom_field_789:denial_reason. Changes to these are scored exactly.

scope_tag.label: Scope tag
scope_tag.helpText: Optional. Only tickets carrying this tag are watched; every other ticket is never read, not even the reply box. Without it, every ticket's reply box is watched but nothing else is read until an AI draft appears.

min_draft_chars.label: Minimum draft length (characters)
min_draft_chars.helpText: Text inserted into the reply box in one go, at least this long, counts as the draft.
